Subject: Follow-up: Pricing & Context Length Profiling (8k / 32k / 128k)

Hi Samir / Lily —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

Summary of needs:
- Primary use case: AI-assisted analytics insights in the product (multi-turn chat + long-report generation).
- Expected throughput: mix of interactive sessions (~100 concurrent users) and batched report generation overnight.
- Quality requirement: high fidelity on long-context summarization and tables.

Questions we discussed that affect pricing: token volumes and context length profile. To build an accurate pricing estimate, could you confirm the following (rough numbers are fine):
1) Avg prompt tokens per interactive request (example: 200–400)
2) Avg completion tokens per interactive response (example: 400–800)
3) Avg prompt/completion tokens for nightly batch reports (these can be much larger)
4) Percent of requests that need >8k, >32k, and >128k context (ballpark %)
5) Target budget or target $/1M tokens for modeling unit economics (e.g., target $100–300 per 1M tokens)

I attached a short token profiling spreadsheet (acme_token_profile_v1.xlsx) — please paste numbers into the shaded column and send back; we can turn that into a 12-month cost projection and unit-economics box.

Next steps: if you can fill the sheet by end of week, Jordan and I will put together a pricing estimate and quantization/context recommendation and schedule a 30-min follow-up.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the sheet. I filled out the high-level numbers below (and updated the sheet). These are approximate but should be enough to get a baseline estimate.

Interactive (real-time) sessions:
- Avg prompt tokens: ~250
- Avg completion tokens: ~600
- % requests needing >8k: 5% (long threads)
- % requests needing >32k: ~1%
- % requests needing >128k: 0%

Nightly batch reports (per report):
- Avg prompt tokens: 4,000 (we send full dataset slices + instructions)
- Avg completion tokens: 12,000 (long generated reports)
- % needing >8k: 60%
- % needing >32k: 15%
- % needing >128k: 2% (very large enterprise reports, monthly)

Volume / cadence:
- Interactive: ~50k requests/month
- Nightly reports: ~8k reports/month

Budget / target unit economics:
- Current procurement target: $150–$220 per 1M tokens (all-in preferred)

Let me know if you want breakdowns by environment or sample payloads.

Best,
Samir
Head of Product, Acme Analytics
samir.patel@acme-analytics.com

Samir —

This is perfect, thank you — very helpful. A few quick notes and how we’ll approach the pricing:

1) Unit economics framing: we’ll map your volumes to a blended $/1M tokens across the workload types (interactive vs batch). For batch-heavy customers the effective $/1M can be lower if we use batching, prefix caching, and a quantized model variant for nightly runs.

2) Context length needs: your split suggests we should price for a base 8k model for the interactive flows and provision a 32k capacity tier for the bulk of nightly reports. The ~2% of monthly jobs that require >128k can be handled via on-demand fallbacks (long-run jobs) or a dedicated large-context instance — we’ll include both options in the quote.

3) Inputs we still need to finalize pricing:
- Sample prompt + completion token histograms (if you can export percentiles into the sheet that helps accuracy).
- Any SLA/throughput constraints for nightly jobs (do you need them finished by 6am PST?).

Attached is a preliminary pricing estimate PDF (redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf) showing two scenarios:
A) Blended model with 8k + 32k tiers (recommended)
B) Dedicated 128k enablement for peak monthly reports (premium option)

I’ll run numbers and share a 12-month cost projection and per-1M-token breakdown by Tue; Jordan will follow up on technical sizing and quantization options.

Proposed next step: 30-min call on Wed 6/23 to review the estimate and pick a path. Is 10am PT ok?

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf
